title: PSG49-F7B: linear classical memory, quadratic quantum memory, sample coefficient 49/100

claims.statement: For every integer N>=2 and every s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2 N), the SINGLE PSG49-F7B measured-basis interpreter of proof.md Sections 1-2 applied to the PSG49-F7 algorithm of core-proof.md Section 2, namely family-source.md Sections 1-8 and 11 with fixed q=49/100, f=2599/7401, u(R)=max(1,floor(2599R/7401)), alpha=7/16, the first feasible integer profile and BOTH recomputed literal Qcap and Wcap (the source finite exhaustive branch for n<256), recovers the ENTIRE secret with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8>2/3 from fresh independent mixed coset states. On EVERY execution branch its total sequential charged work obeys T(n)=O(2^((7401/9800)*sqrt(n log2 n)+(3/4)*sqrt(n)*(log2 n)^(-7/16))), with exact growth index 1/2; n>=2 defines the positive envelope and n=1 is covered by the finite branch. All constants are absolute. All acquisitions, discarded copies, retries, wrong-label branches, aborts, addressing, circuit generation, exact Clifford+T gates, precision and preprocessing are charged as proved in proof.md Sections 3-4 and core-proof.md Sections 3-6. All four bounds and the clean fraction-0 guarantee hold jointly for this same configuration.

For every integer N>=2 and every s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2 N), the SINGLE PSG49-F7B measured-basis interpreter of proof.md Sections 1-2 applied to the PSG49-F7 algorithm of core-proof.md Section 2, namely family-source.md Sections 1-8 and 11 with fixed q=49/100, f=2599/7401, u(R)=max(1,floor(2599R/7401)), alpha=7/16, the first feasible integer profile and BOTH recomputed literal Qcap and Wcap (the source finite exhaustive branch for n<256), recovers the ENTIRE secret with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8>2/3 from fresh independent mixed coset states. For this SAME configuration the guaranteed malformed-copy fraction is exactly epsilon(n)=0, under the exact clean error model in proof.md Section 5 and the structured error_model. Every acquired sample must be independent ideal rho_s; no behavior is promised for malformed copies. The unconditional success >=1-2^-8 and all four every-branch resource bounds hold jointly. This is not an impossibility claim about positive tolerance.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
